visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a square white sign illuminated from within, displaying the black calligraphy text '輝室' against a traditional wooden-slated fence. Beyond the fence is a lush green tree and a white residential building. (2) A transition shows a historical plaque titled 'Yan Ching-ling Memorial Hall' in Chinese, explaining the site's significance. This is followed by a wide shot of the exterior, featuring a gray modern building integrated with a traditional Japanese-style dark-tiled roof and white gravel paths. (3) The scene shifts indoors, capturing the dark wooden floors, sliding shoji screens, and minimalist furniture. Panning shots showcase different dining areas, including a room with a large wooden table and pink chairs, and a bar-style counter facing windows. (4) A sequence of close-ups focuses on various dishes: a dark, seeded bread roll being torn apart by hand with red-nailed fingers, a creamy yellow soup with croutons being lifted by a spoon, and a stack of vegetables and seafood with cucumbers. (5) The main courses are presented—one with sliced pork over rice and another with thick noodles and large grilled shrimp. Two women are seen sitting at a table, one taking a bite of food and expressing delight with closed eyes. (6) A creative dessert appears on a wooden shelf, followed by a close-up of a sugar-coated persimmon treat wrapped in white sugar fibers and red edible paper. A woman is filmed eating the long sugar fibers playfully by pulling them with her mouth. (7) The video concludes by returning to the exterior sign as the pricing is displayed on screen via text overlay.
